# Xdebug

- Project: https://xdebug.org · Source: https://github.com/xdebug/xdebug
- Not bundled: downloaded in the app on request (Dependencies → Xdebug) from xdebug.org into `data\modules\xdebug\`
  (one DLL per installed PHP version). Loaded only by the php-cgi of sites with Xdebug switched on.
